title: Design System: Nội thất Hoa Đô

display.purpose: Page heroes, section headings. The showroom's signage.

shadows.name: shadow-xs
shadows.purpose: Default resting state for flat elements.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Cards and elevated surfaces at rest.

shadows.name: shadow-gold
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons only. The only tinted shadow.

motion.name: ease-default
motion.purpose: Primary easing for most transitions. Fast start, gentle deceleration.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Overshoot for interactive feedback: button active, menu open.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Standard transitions: nav underline, button lift.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Entrance animations, image scale on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Golden Sand CTA. The showroom's invitation to act.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">KHÁM PHÁ <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 28px; background: #C7A35D; color: #2B2B2B; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(199,163,93,.20); transition: background 0.25s, transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), box-shadow 0.25s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #A8804A; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(199,163,93,.35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); }

components.name: Dark Button
components.description: Charcoal secondary CTA for light backgrounds.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 28px; background: #2B2B2B; color: #F5F2EC; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.25s, transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); } .ds-btn-dark:hover { background: #3A3A3A; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-dark:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent with Charcoal border. Fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 28px; background: transparent; color: #2B2B2B; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1.5px solid #2B2B2B; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.25s, color 0.25s, transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #2B2B2B; color: #F5F2EC; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Product display card with hover lift and image zoom.

components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(43,43,43,.07); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(43,43,43,.14); } .ds-card-img { aspect-ratio: 4/5; overflow: hidden; background: #EDE8DF; } .ds-card-img img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 0.55s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-img img { transform: scale(1.06); } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px 20px 20px; } .ds-card-name { font-family: Cormorant Garamond, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 500; color: #2B2B2B; display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-name { color: #A8804A; } .ds-card-price { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; } .ds-price-now { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2B2B2B; } .ds-price-was { font-size: 0.78rem; color: #A8A8A8; text-decoration: line-through; }

components.description: Standard form input with gold focus border.

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Desktop nav link with gold underline reveal.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4A4A4A; text-decoration: none; position: relative; padding-bottom: 3px; transition: color 0.25s; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1.5px; background: #C7A35D; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #2B2B2B; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

components.css: .ds-pill { padding: 8px 20px; border: 1px solid #E4DDD2; border-radius: 100px; background: transparent; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; color: #4A4A4A; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: #2B2B2B; color: #2B2B2B; } .ds-pill-active { background: #2B2B2B; border-color: #2B2B2B; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-pill-active:hover { background: #2B2B2B; border-color: #2B2B2B; color: #FFFFFF; }

narrative.overview:
Hoa Đô's digital presence is a curated showroom where silence speaks. Every surface, every transition, every typographic choice serves one purpose: to let the furniture command the room. The interface recedes — generous whitespace, muted tones, precise alignments — so the product photography can do what no UI element can: make someone want to touch a screen.

The system rejects noise. No promotional banners fighting for attention (this is not Shopee). No identical card grids filling space (this is not IKEA). No gradient-text hero metrics (this is not a SaaS pitch deck). Hoa Đô's brand is carried by restraint: the gold accent appears sparingly, the typography whispers authority, and the page rhythm mimics the experience of walking through a physical showroom — expansive moments, intimate pauses, deliberate reveals.
keyCharacteristics: Photography-first: UI exists to frame, not to compete
Restrained color: warm neutrals + one disciplined accent
Serif + sans pairing for editorial authority
Scroll-driven choreography with GSAP, never gratuitous
Dark sections as contrast punctuation, not default

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Golden Sand is the only chromatic accent. No secondary color, no tertiary color. If a new element needs color, it uses Golden Sand or a transparency of it.

rules.name: The Quiet Authority Rule
rules.body: Display headings never shout. Maximum clamp ceiling is 5rem for hero-scale text. Letter-spacing stays at -0.015em.

rules.name: The Warm Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows use the Charcoal tone (43,43,43), never pure black. The gold-tinted shadow is reserved for primary buttons — nowhere else.

dos: Do let product photography fill at least 40% of any homepage viewport.
Do use Golden Sand exclusively for interactive accents. Its rarity is the system's discipline.
Do vary section spacing for rhythm. Not every section gets the same padding.
Do use GSAP ScrollTrigger for entrance animations. Each reveal should fit what it reveals.
Do include @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) alternatives for every animation.
Do maintain ≥4.5:1 contrast ratio for all body text.
donts: Don't add a second accent color. Golden Sand is the only chromatic voice.
Don't use identical card grids as the default layout.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism cards, or hero-metric templates.
Don't add promotional banners, flash sale ribbons, or discount-heavy layouts.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px as colored accent).
Don't put numbered section markers (01/02/03) on every section.
Don't apply eyebrow kickers above every section heading.
Don't exceed 5rem for hero heading clamp max.
